### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_profile` | Return the connected mailbox's email address and its message and thread totals, for example {"emailAddress": "alice@example.com", "messagesTotal": 1532, "threadsTotal": 811}. Use it to learn which mailbox is connected. | yes | no | auto |
| `search_threads` | Search the mailbox's threads and return their ids and snippets, newest first. q uses Gmail search syntax, for example \`from:alice@example.com is:unread newer\_than:7d\` or \`subject:invoice has:attachment\`; leave it out to list the latest threads. labelIds keeps only threads with all of those labels (ids from list\_labels, such as INBOX). Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_thread` | Read every message of one thread by its id (from search\_threads), oldest first. format=metadata returns headers only (pick them with metadataHeaders, for example From, To, Subject, Date); format=full also returns the bodies, base64url-encoded in payload.parts\[\].body.data. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_message` | Read one message by its id, for example 18c2f0d7a1b2c3d4. format=metadata returns headers only; format=full returns the body parts, base64url-encoded; format=raw returns the whole RFC 2822 message in raw. Before replying, read the parent with format=metadata and metadataHeaders Message-ID, References and Subject: the reply needs them. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_labels` | List the mailbox's labels with their ids: system labels such as INBOX, SENT, UNREAD and STARRED, and the user's own, such as Label\_12. Use the ids with search\_threads, label\_thread and unlabel\_thread. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_drafts` | List saved drafts with their ids and message ids, newest first. q filters them with Gmail search syntax, for example \`subject:proposal\`. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `create_draft` | Save a draft without sending it. message.raw is the whole RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded, for example the encoding of "To: bob@example.com\\r\\nSubject: Hello\\r\\n\\r\\nHi Bob". To draft a reply, set message.threadId to the thread's id, put In-Reply-To and References headers with the parent's Message-ID in the message, and keep its Subject (read them with get\_message first). Returns the draft id for send\_draft. | no | no | ask |
| `send_draft` | Send a draft saved earlier, by the id create\_draft or list\_drafts returned, for example r-5108413232411426193. The draft is removed and the sent message is returned. | no | no | ask |
| `send_message` | Send an email. raw is the whole RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded, for example the encoding of "To: bob@example.com\\r\\nSubject: Hello\\r\\n\\r\\nHi Bob". To reply in a thread, set threadId to the thread's id, put In-Reply-To and References headers with the parent's Message-ID in the message, and keep its Subject (read them with get\_message first); otherwise Gmail starts a new thread. | no | no | ask |
| `label_thread` | Add labels to every message of a thread, by label id from list\_labels, for example addLabelIds=\["STARRED"\] or \["Label\_12"\]. Adding a label the thread already has changes nothing. | no | no | ask |
| `unlabel_thread` | Remove labels from every message of a thread, by label id from list\_labels: removing UNREAD marks it read, removing INBOX archives it. Removing a label the thread does not have changes nothing. | no | yes | deny |
| `create_label` | Create a label of the user's own, for example name="Receipts" or a nested "Clients/Acme". Returns its id for label\_thread. | no | no | ask |
| `trash_thread` | Move every message of a thread to the trash, by thread id from search\_threads. | no | yes | deny |

### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search_threads` | List the email threads that match a Gmail search query, with each message's subject and a snippet. | yes | no | ask |
| `get_thread` | Read one email thread and its messages, by thread ID. | yes | no | ask |
| `get_message` | Read one email message, by message ID. | yes | no | ask |
| `list_labels` | List the user's own labels and their IDs. | yes | no | ask |
| `list_drafts` | List draft emails, optionally filtered by a query. | yes | no | ask |
| `create_draft` | Create a draft email, optionally as a reply to a message. The draft is not sent. | no | no | ask |
